title.zh: 原子氢弹性散射频率聚合

summary: Per spatial cell, aggregate the atomic elastic Alpha frequencies and the branch-time SIG_H_H re-contraction into the H-H+, H-H2, H-H and total elastic Omega frequencies, the H bulk x-flow velocity, and the perpendicular second moment feeding the Wpp floor.

identity.relation: Omega_H_P[k] = max(sum(Vr2pidVr * ((Alpha_H_P[:,:,k]*fH[:,:,k]) @ dVx)) / (nH[k]*DeltaVx), 0) with DeltaVx = sign((VxH[k]-vxi[k])/Vth) * max(|(VxH[k]-vxi[k])/Vth|, DeltaVx_tol); Omega_H_H2[k] analogous against vxH2[k]; Omega_H_H[k] = max(sum(Vr2pidVr * ((Alpha_H_H*fH[:,:,k]) @ dVx)) / (nH[k]*Wpp), 0) with Alpha_H_H = F^-1(SIG_H_H @ F(fH[:,:,k])) re-contracted at branch time and Wpp = sign(Wperp_paraH[k]) * max(|Wperp_paraH[k]|, Wpp_tol); Omega_EL = Omega_H_P + Omega_H_H2 + Omega_H_H; VxH[k] = Vth * sum(Vr2pidVr * (fH[:,:,k] @ (vx*dVx))) / nH[k].
identity.direction: atomic Alpha frequencies (Alpha_H_P, Alpha_H_H2) + SIG_H_H matrix + branch-time state (fH, nH, MH_H_sum) + mesh/weights (Vr2pidVr, dVx, vr, vx) + flow targets (Vth, vxi, vxH2) + projection kernel (vr2_2vx2_2D) -> three elastic Omega families, their total, the bulk x-flow velocity VxH, and the perpendicular second moment Wperp_paraH
identity.definition: The saved source's per-cell Omega block (kinetic_h.py:1116-1188): each elastic channel reduces the pointwise Alpha*fH product over the velocity mesh and divides by the density times a sign-floored drift difference (or the floored perpendicular second moment for the H-H viscosity channel); the H-H channel re-contracts Alpha_H_H from SIG_H_H with the branch-time fH through the legacy Fortran-order Work carrier. The legacy symbolic sign (int(x>0)-int(x<0)) is preserved. All three Omega families are clamped at zero (outputs nonnegative by construction). Wperp_paraH dual branch (kinetic_h.py:1159-1167): sum(MH_H_sum) <= 0 selects the direct vr2-2*(vx-VxH/Vth)^2 projection; otherwise the accumulated-moment reduction -(vr2_2vx2_2D*(MH_H_sum-fH)) is integrated. NOTE the <= 0 test: the molecular side uses < 0, so a zero accumulator takes opposite paths on the two sides.
identity.model: the saved formal implementation, ported verbatim with documented fail-closed hardenings (see verification and known_limitations)
identity.geometry: per spatial cell k: velocity-space quadrature reductions over the (nvr,nvx) slice, producing one scalar per (nx,) output field
identity.coordinates: cylindrical (vr,vx) velocity space, v/vth normalized; Vth in m/s (or the caller's normalized speed); densities source-discrete; the callable performs no implicit unit conversion
identity.boundary: finite aligned inputs of the declared shapes; nH entries must be positive wherever any elastic channel is enabled; Vth, DeltaVx_tol, Wpp_tol must be finite positive scalars; the three Omega families are clamped at zero so no negative cells occur (unlike the Alpha/SIG families)
assumptions: The Alpha frequencies arrive from the atomic contraction and the SIG_H_H matrix from the atomic collision-matrix assembly; this operator performs no assembly or gating of its own beyond the documented re-contraction.
The DeltaVx_tol=0.01 and Wpp_tol=0.001 floors are source hardcoded defaults; their physical adequacy is an expert-review item.

The Wperp_paraH accumulated-moment branch (MH_H_sum > 0) is the source's '#NOTE Not Tested Yet' region; both branches are implemented verbatim but the source's execution evidence covers the direct-projection branch.
No external atomic-physics reference is bound: the saved package records that residual as validation_oracle_gap.

inputs.name: fH
inputs.description: Atomic neutral H velocity distribution at branch time, one (nvr,nvx) slice per spatial cell.
inputs.constraints: Finite; shape (nvr,nvx,nx) exactly; its leading axes define N = nvr*nvx for SIG_H_H.

inputs.name: nH
inputs.description: Atomic H density per spatial cell.
inputs.constraints: Finite 1-D of size nx; entries must be positive wherever any elastic channel is enabled (registered hardening: the saved arm silently skipped the Omega block and returned zeros).

inputs.name: Alpha_H_P
inputs.description: H-H+ elastic Alpha frequency field (atomic contraction output).
inputs.units: s^-1 (subject to the caller's assembled measure)

inputs.name: Alpha_H_H2
inputs.description: H-H2 elastic Alpha frequency field (atomic contraction output).
inputs.units: s^-1 (subject to the caller's assembled measure)

inputs.name: SIG_H_H
inputs.description: H-H elastic collision matrix (atomic collision-matrix assembly output), re-contracted against the branch-time fH.
inputs.constraints: Finite; 2-D square with order exactly nvr*nvx.

inputs.name: Vr2pidVr
inputs.constraints: Finite 1-D of size nvr; entries nonnegative.

inputs.name: dVx
inputs.constraints: Finite 1-D of size nvx; entries positive.

inputs.name: Vth
inputs.description: H thermal speed used to normalize the drift difference.
inputs.constraints: Finite and positive (registered hardening: the saved arm validates nothing here and a zero Vth would silently produce non-finite outputs).

inputs.name: vxi
inputs.description: Ion flow velocity per spatial cell, the Omega_H_P drift target.

inputs.name: vxH2
inputs.description: Molecular H2 flow velocity per spatial cell, the Omega_H_H2 drift target.

inputs.name: MH_H_sum
inputs.description: Accumulated H-H elastic moment at branch time; its sign total selects the Wperp_paraH branch.

inputs.name: vr2_2vx2_2D
inputs.description: vr^2 - 2*vx^2 projection kernel on the (vr,vx) mesh, used by the accumulated-moment branch.

inputs.name: DeltaVx_tol
inputs.constraints: Finite and positive scalar (registered hardening: a NaN tolerance bypasses the saved arm's `tol <= 0` check).

inputs.name: Wpp_tol
inputs.constraints: Finite and positive scalar (registered hardening as for DeltaVx_tol).

inputs.name: H_P_EL
inputs.description: Enable flag for the Omega_H_P channel.

inputs.name: H_H2_EL
inputs.description: Enable flag for the Omega_H_H2 channel.

inputs.name: H_H_EL
inputs.description: Enable flag for the Omega_H_H channel and the Wperp_paraH projection.

outputs.name: VxH
outputs.description: H bulk x-flow velocity per spatial cell.
outputs.constraints: Finite (fail closed otherwise); zero where all channels are disabled.

outputs.name: Omega_H_P
outputs.units: s^-1 (subject to the caller's assembled measure)
outputs.constraints: Finite; nonnegative (zero-clamped by the source semantics).

outputs.name: Omega_H_H2
outputs.units: s^-1 (subject to the caller's assembled measure)

outputs.name: Omega_H_H
outputs.description: H-H elastic (viscosity) collision frequency from the branch-time SIG_H_H re-contraction.
outputs.units: s^-1 (subject to the caller's assembled measure)

outputs.name: Omega_EL
outputs.description: Total elastic collision frequency, the exact channel sum.
outputs.units: s^-1 (subject to the caller's assembled measure)
outputs.constraints: Finite; equals Omega_H_P + Omega_H_H2 + Omega_H_H exactly.

outputs.name: Wperp_paraH
outputs.description: Perpendicular second moment feeding the Wpp floor of the H-H channel.
outputs.constraints: Finite; selected by the sign of sum(MH_H_sum) (<= 0: direct vr2 projection; > 0: accumulated-moment reduction).

preconditions: Branch-time state (fH, nH, MH_H_sum), upstream Alpha fields and the assembled SIG_H_H matrix exist with aligned shapes.
The caller supplies the mesh, weights, flow targets and floors; this operator performs no gridding or cache handling.
supported: Atomic elastic Omega aggregation (Omega_H_P, Omega_H_H2, Omega_H_H, Omega_EL) with VxH and Wperp_paraH on a declared velocity carrier.
excluded: The molecular H2 aggregation, the Omega_* composition into scattered-source sums (elastic-frequency-channels / elastic-regeneration-aggregation consumers), Do_Alpha_*/Do_Sig_Gating, KH.Internal cache lifecycle, the Wperp_paraH accumulated-moment branch's physical validation, and external physical validation.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError when any array argument is misaligned (SIG_H_H not (N,N) square for the carrier, nH/vxi/vxH2 not (nx,), Alpha/MH_H_sum not (nvr,nvx,nx), weights/kernel mismatched), when any entry is non-finite, when nH has a non-positive entry while any elastic channel is enabled, when Vth/DeltaVx_tol/Wpp_tol is not a finite positive scalar, or when a tolerance is non-positive.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Raises ValueError if any returned field aggregates to a non-finite value; no partial results are returned.

python.signature: assemble_atomic_hydrogen_omega_frequencies(fH, nH, Alpha_H_P, Alpha_H_H2, SIG_H_H, Vr2pidVr, dVx, vr, vx, Vth, vxi, vxH2, MH_H_sum, vr2_2vx2_2D, DeltaVx_tol=0.01, Wpp_tol=0.001, H_P_EL=True, H_H2_EL=True, H_H_EL=True)

example.description: Aggregate the atomic Omega family on a small carrier from the r66/r67 upstream outputs and check the total is the exact channel sum.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from scirel.kinetic import (
    assemble_atomic_hydrogen_collision_matrices,
    contract_atomic_hydrogen_alpha_frequencies,
    assemble_atomic_hydrogen_omega_frequencies,
)
nvr, nvx, nx = 2, 2, 1
carrier = dict(vr=[0.5, 1.0], vx=[-1.0, 1.0],
               Vr2pidVr=[1.7671458676442586, 3.141592653589793],
               dVx=[2.0, 2.0], Tnorm=1.0, mu=1.0)
sig = assemble_atomic_hydrogen_collision_matrices(**carrier)
fi = np.ones((nvr, nvx, nx))
alpha = contract_atomic_hydrogen_alpha_frequencies(
    sig["SIG_CX"], sig["SIG_H_H"], sig["SIG_H_H2"], sig["SIG_H_P"],
    fi, np.full(nx, 1e18), fi, fi)
kernel = np.asarray(carrier["vr"])[:, None] ** 2 - 2.0 * np.asarray(carrier["vx"])[None, :] ** 2
out = assemble_atomic_hydrogen_omega_frequencies(
    fi, np.full(nx, 1e18), alpha["Alpha_H_P"], alpha["Alpha_H_H2"],
    sig["SIG_H_H"], np.asarray(carrier["Vr2pidVr"]), np.asarray(carrier["dVx"]),
    np.asarray(carrier["vr"]), np.asarray(carrier["vx"]), 1.0,
    np.full(nx, 0.1), np.full(nx, 0.05), fi, kernel)
assert np.array_equal(out["Omega_EL"], out["Omega_H_P"] + out["Omega_H_H2"] + out["Omega_H_H"])
assert np.all(out["Omega_EL"] >= 0.0)
example.expected: The three channels aggregate to Omega_EL exactly and stay nonnegative; a non-positive density with an enabled channel raises ValueError.

scope: Bit-identical agreement with the saved KN1DPy implementation.
Input and failure contracts, including the registered hardenings.
verification.evidence_ceiling: The maintained direct tests establish every declared output against an independent closed-form reduction oracle built over manufactured inputs (the saved packages' 1e-12-relative/1e-9-absolute budgets), the branch-time SIG re-contraction against a Fortran-order versus C-order discriminating carrier, the zero clamps, the exact Omega_EL channel sum, channel-switch gating, input immutability, the Wperp branch selectors (including the <= 0 versus < 0 asymmetry between the arms), and the registered fail-closed hardenings. In the environment-gated replay all six outputs agree bit for bit with the saved KN1DPy implementation pinned by SHA-256 on fixtures covering both Wperp branch paths per arm. That replay is provisional historical development evidence, not qualified-L1 provenance. No test establishes the aggregation against an external atomic-physics reference; the saved package records that residual as validation_oracle_gap.
known_limitations: The saved bundle sits in the re-review archive and KN1DPy's strict D1 qualification is withdrawn; the historical replay evidence cannot be upgraded to qualified-L1 provenance without a new strict freeze and independent review of the source project.

The registered fail-closed hardenings (positive-density gating, finite positive scalar Vth/tolerances, non-finite output gate) deliberately diverge from the saved arm's silent skip-through/NaN-returning behavior on those boundaries.

On a velocity carrier and flow targets whose drift difference is exactly zero, the source legacy sign(0)=0 makes the floored denominator 0*(...)=0.0 and the channel degenerates to NaN; the saved operator.md records this legitimate-input hazard. The port's non-finite output gate now rejects it with ValueError instead of returning NaN; whether to normalize the sign to a zero-protected np.sign form is an open expert question (registered by the saved package).

The Wperp_paraH accumulated-moment branch (MH_H_sum > 0) is the source's '#NOTE Not Tested Yet' region; the port implements it verbatim and reproduces it in the branch-selector oracle tests, but no source execution evidence exists for it.
The DeltaVx_tol=0.01 and Wpp_tol=0.001 floors are source hardcoded defaults; their physical adequacy is an open expert question.
